entries.en: It's almost exam season.[n]Have you been studying?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If it's all right with you,[n]why don't we study together?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm at the underground passage in[n]Shibuya, so feel free to stop by.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what's it going to be? Do you want to[n]go see Yusuke?
entries.uk: Ну, що вирішиш? Хочеш піти[n]до Юсуке?

entries.en: I should be able to deepen[n]our bond since I have [clr 1][var 5][clr 27][n]of the [var 2] arcana...
